# truenas_ui_restart (Action)

Restarts the web UI after `delay` seconds, applying UI settings. Aborts every HTTP connection, including the provider's.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `delay` (Number) How long to wait before the UI is restarted. TrueNAS does not report this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
